data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-n-y', meaning 'to be born, to come into existence'. In Islamic spiritual traditions, Jina signifies a person born of great virtue and spiritual purity. The name Jina carries the meaning “Born of great virtue” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jina usually hope their child will grow to embody born of great virtue and live with faith, good character and purpose.
